title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting how Bharat's growth story is making the Blue Revolution another success story
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan.    Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan notes that under PM , Shri Narendra Modi, Bharat's growth story is making the Blue Revolution another success story.  The article underlines how India is now looking beyond its shores to unlock its marine wealth. Also Sustainable fisheries are creating new opportunities for coastal communities, youth and women, thus strengthening the economic life of coastal India.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“A must-read article by @VPIndia Thiru @CPR_VP, in which he writes that under PM @narendramodi's  leadership, Bharat's growth story is making the Blue Revolution another success story. He says India is now looking beyond its shores to unlock its marine wealth. Sustainable fisheries are creating new opportunities for coastal communities, youth and women. This is also strengthening the economic life of coastal India.
